facts.business: Rudrabhishek Enterprises Limited provides project consultancy services and recognizes revenue using the percentage of completion method for fixed price contracts.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter identified regarding revenue recognition for fixed price contracts using percentage of completion method and unbilled revenue estimation

key_risks: Revenue recognition accuracy for fixed price contracts using percentage of completion method
Estimation and assumptions involved in determining stage of completion
Unbilled revenue computation based on manual verification and estimates
